name: Valerie Hadnot
why: 1994 Talisman residence hall portrait grid, p. 35, Poland Hall. The grid is five portraits across and six rows deep, with each row's five names, class years and hometowns printed in order in the column to the right. The sixth and last row reads David Guffey Sr., Valerie Hadnot Jr., Jim Hannah Jr., Jason Charles Hays Fr., Angela S. Hoagland Sr., and this is the second cell of that row. Hadnot is the only person of that surname in either the 1993 or the 1994 index, and the 1993 index gives her a second page, 202, an organization page, alongside her class portrait at p. 58. A clean studio headshot, in focus, looking at the camera; small only because the scan is 816 pixels to a printed page.

src.label: 1994 Talisman, p. 35, Poland Hall portraits; indexed "Hadnot, Valerie, 35"

name: Devon Moore
why: 1994 Talisman Sigma Alpha Epsilon portrait grid, p. 69. The grid is five portraits across and three rows deep, with each row's five names, class years and hometowns printed in order in the column to the right. The third row reads Steve Lagermann Sr., Jason Martin So., Lyle McMillin Fr., Eric McWilliams Sr., Devon Moore Fr., and this is the fifth and last cell of that row. He is the only Devon Moore in either the 1993 or the 1994 index, and a freshman in the 1994 volume is a sophomore in 1994-95, the first year the archive records him in SGA. A clear studio headshot, small only because the scan is 816 pixels to a printed page.

name: David Apple
why: Cropped out of the Sigma Phi Epsilon chapter photograph on p. 200 of the 1993 Talisman. The chapter stands in two clean rows of five, and the caption prints two rows of exactly five names in order, so the positions line up one to one: he is the fourth of the five in the front row, the man in the pale sweater and dark tie, counting from the left. The 1993 index carries one Apple in the whole volume and gives him this page alone. No portrait grid cell exists for him in either digitised volume, so this is the only face of him the archive holds. Soft and small, and there are shoulders of the men behind him at the edges of the frame.
caption_quote: First Row: Chris Sullivan, J.P. Muse, Dow Rasdall, David Apple, David Gabe
